new_aggregate_records.name: Backbox general illumination — assembly total
new_aggregate_records.socket: #555 wedge; BOM lists 37 white sockets, part 24-8817.
new_aggregate_records.note: The reproduced 50013-IN insert-panel BOM lists 37 #555 bulbs, in addition to six #906 flashers. No per-socket coordinates or split between GI strings has been validated. GI output labels conflict between factory manual pages.

new_aggregate_records.name: Playfield general illumination — verify installed sockets
new_aggregate_records.socket: Mixed/uncertain per-position families. The BOM lists #44 socket assemblies and #555 GI lamp boards; inspect each installed holder.
new_aggregate_records.note: Do not interpret the old all-#555 GI polygons as a physical inventory. The reproduced playfield BOM includes 35 A-11905 #44 socket/bulb assemblies and #555 GI lamp-board assemblies. Individual assignments, exact installed total and GI-string labels are not established here. No shaded region or individual GI socket is drawn.
new_aggregate_records.quantityEvidence: No reconciled per-socket total; do not sum overlapping assembly and circuit records.

exclusions.finding: Not Used on p. 2-35; no bulb or marker added.
Drop-target coil AE-26-1200 in p. 2-38 is not a flasher bulb, despite conflicting p. 2-39 wording; no lamp added.
All 21 overlays removed. The photo is a visual reference and cannot validate factory IDs, families, circuit membership or a complete inventory.
p. 2-38 says Not Used; p. 2-39 says CPU String. No fitted/absent claim or socket location is assigned from these conflicting labels.

limits: 61 circuit references have retraced manual feature markers (63 drawn positions). These are feature/insert locations, not inspected socket centers.
L52 is documented as two lamps within a skull assembly, with a #555/#44 source conflict. No playfield dot.
L84 is a cabinet button with no verified map coordinate.
All flasher and GI socket coordinates are withheld. Quantities printed in a table or BOM do not validate individual locations.
Actual machine modifications, every installed bulb, and wire-to-socket mapping require inspection/testing of the machine.
